description: Set a Magento configuration value on a Cloud environment by running `bin/magento config:set` via SSH. Use the scope/scope_code parameters to target a specific website or store view.

encrypted.description: Encrypt the value before saving (for sensitive data like API keys).

scope.description: The configuration scope. Defaults to 'default' (global) if omitted.

scope_code.description: The website code or store view code the scope applies to, e.g. 'base' or 'default'. Required when scope is 'websites' or 'stores'.

value.description: The value to set for the configuration path

name: set_cloud_config
